summary: Elevate your NGO's fundraising efforts with our Advanced Fundraising Strategies Training. Learn innovative techniques to maximize your impact and reach.
lede: Fundraising strategy for NGOs helps fundraising professionals, leaders and program teams plan resource mobilization beyond one-off proposals. Participants learn to map and diversify funding portfolios, research and prioritize donors, and develop donor-facing cases and proposals. They also practice building donor relationships and using fundraising data to assess performance and risk.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals in NGOs and non-profits who are involved in designing, implementing, or supporting fundraising and resource mobilization.
audience: NGO executive directors and senior leaders
Grant writers and proposal development specialists
modules: The Strategic Role of Fundraising in NGOs
Crafting Compelling Cases for Support and Value Propositions
Fundraising Data, KPIs, and Risk Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of fundraising principles and experience in NGO operations. A background in proposal writing or donor engagement is beneficial but not mandatory.
